name: simple-rpn-calculator
description: Evaluate reverse Polish notation with add and subtract.
--: - prettier and markdownlint-cli are devDependencies. yarn.lock is what local runs and CI share.
- .prettierignore lists *.md, so Prettier skips Markdown and markdownlint formats it.
- scripts/lint-format.js routes arguments. The package scripts call node, which Yarn provides, so they do not need a POSIX shell.
- If no files were given, Prettier checks . and markdownlint checks **/*.md.

- A directory is expanded to **/*.md under that directory. Other paths are kept only when they end in .md. markdownlint-cli lints every path you hand it, so those paths go through in one invocation. One failure fails the run.
- The helper runs those programs with the same node Yarn started. markdownlint-cli stays inside the Yarn cache zip, and that path is not executable on its own.
